messages:
Maya: Kicking off canary for release `2026.03.17` — plan is a 3-step gradual ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~45m. Need owners for each window, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Pinged folks who volunteered earlier. Who can take 10:00-10:15 PT (first ramp)?
Jasper: I can own the first window (10:00-10:15 PT). I'll run smoke and watch p95 and error-rate. Will post checks.
Anika: I can take second window (10:15-10:35 PT). Quick question: is the 5% cohort global sampling or geo-weighted?
Maya: 5% is global sample but we bias for internal + EU small subset (to catch GDPR routing). Cohort mapping: 5% = internal + 1% EU + 4% US sample (user_id % 100 < 5). 25% adds EU+APAC partial buckets (user_id % 100 < 25). Details in the rollout sheet I linked earlier.
Tom: What are the exact smoke commands so I can run them quickly when the first ramp starts?
Maya: Smoke checklist (minimal):
```
# health + logs
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=serving --since=5m | rg "ERROR|WARN" || true
# quick e2e sampling
./scripts/run_e2e.sh --sample 100 --model=redwood-v1 --timeout 60
# perf quick-check (local)
python tools/quick_latency_check.py --p99 --concurrency 8
```
Jasper: I'll monitor p95 <= 200ms, error-rate < 0.5%. If error-rate breaches 0.6% for 3m I'll call for rollback. I'll post metric screenshots to the channel.
Eli: Rollback plan: we keep `redwood-v1-20260316` pinned. Revert command is `releases revert --id cf-2026-03-17-01 --to redwood-v1-20260316`. Ops: ensure `releases` CLI access for Jasper/Tom/Anika.
Anika: Confirmed I have access. For second window I'll also watch memory and GC churn on pods and run a quick prompt-quality spot-check using `./evals/quick_prompt_check.py` on a 50-case set.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary kickoff 2026-03-17T17:00:00Z (run id cf-2026-03-17-01). Automated traffic ramping enabled (5% -> 25% -> 100).
sre-bot: Alerting rule uploaded: `canary-error-rate` if >0.5% for 3m -> notify #eng-oncall and pager.
Tom: I'll be on watch from 09:55 PT and run the checklist at T0+2m. Will post results.
Maya: Action items: Jasper = smoke + p95/error monitoring for first ramp. Anika = second ramp observability + prompt-quality checks. Tom = run smoke script and e2e quick tests. Eli = verify rollback command access and that the older image is healthy to pin.
Jasper: If we see a sustained 0.6% error for 4m or p95 spike > 400ms, I'll initiate rollback and call @oncall.
Anika: :thumbsup: I'll also watch for any skew in embeddings latency — those have previously regressed on canaries.
Maya: Thanks. I'll kick the run at the scheduled time and post the T0 message. Please keep replies short in this thread during the rollout.
Tom: Understood — will post PASS/FAIL + notes.
Maya: Final note — rollback window is 30m after full ramp; if anything odd persists we plan a staged backoff rather than full rollback.
Eli: Documented rollback and pinned image verified. All good from infra.
Maya: Great. Starting in ~10m.
